name: Quartr
tagline: Earnings calls, transcripts, and AI chat across thousands of public companies.
description: Quartr is a financial research platform that turns clunky investor-relations pages into a podcast-style experience — live earnings calls, searchable transcripts with text-to-audio, investor presentations, and filings across 13,000+ public companies. AI chat lets users question 50M+ documents with answers linked to the source. It ships as a free mobile app, the Quartr Pro web platform, and a real-time data API used by 700+ financial institutions and AI companies.
insight: Began as a free consumer app surfacing earnings-call audio, then expanded into a pro research platform and a real-time data API.
edge: Turns clunky IR pages into a podcast-style earnings-call app with searchable transcripts, then layers AI chat over 13,000+ companies — free on mobile.
cons: Pro and API pricing is quote-only
Pro features gated behind paid plan

references.title: Quartr Review: Listen to Companies' Earnings Calls Free
